name: Ink and watercolor
about: The project's starting style guide for seeded images. Contributors' style guides can replace it. Setting notes follow the book's world notes: Veridia is green, wooded, stone-built and calm; Dzego is low-rise, dense and electronic with playful cartoon aesthetics.
prompt: Storybook illustration, fine ink linework with soft watercolor washes, gentle natural light, slightly stylized proportions, no text, no lettering, no writing, no logos, no numbers.

settings.veridia: Palette of muted greens, stone greys and warm earth tones; calm, clean, wooded, stone buildings blended with trees.
settings.dzego: Palette of warm night colors with pops of neon pink, cyan and yellow; dense low-rise streets, glowing shop lights, cute cartoon animal murals, a lively electronic feel.
settings.united-cities: Palette of cool blues, glass and concrete greys; a busy modern city of mixed old and new towers.
settings.arctic: Palette of icy whites, pale blues and steel; severe, orderly, crystalline architecture.
